name: The Arch of Departure
visual_description: A weathered triple archway—each passage a different hue, a different path. Moss creeps over the stones like veins.
meaning: The necessity of parting. Choice carved in stone.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh walked through all three.** I have only ever passed through one, and I cannot go back. I wonder where it went. I wonder if it misses me.
